full_track.tags: K-Pop R&B ballad. The track opens with a solo tenor saxophone performing a rubato, jazz-influenced melody with heavy vibrato and breathy articulation. A clean, chorus-effected electric guitar enters with jazz-style chord voicings. The arrangement transitions into a mid-tempo groove at 85 BPM in the key of G Major. A warm, rounded electric bass performs syncopated lines. The drums consist of a crisp snare and a soft kick drum. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational baritone register with light compression and subtle plate reverb. The vocal delivery is rhythmic and follows the syncopation of the bassline.
